blurb: Guests receive massage therapy treatments focused on assessment and treatment of soft tissue and joint dysfunction, injury, pain, and physical disorders. Treatments aim to develop, maintain, rehabilitate or augment physical function, relieve pain, and promote health. Services include general wellness care such as pre/post-natal care, infant massage, stress management, sports training, injury prevention, and performance enhancement.
